name: Experienced Flanker (Combat)
body:
You have spent countless hours fighting in tandem with others.

Prerequisite(s): Base attack bonus +6.

Benefit: You gain a +4 bonus on attack rolls when flanking rather than a +2 and gain a +1 bonus on damage rolls while flanking.
